memories.text: function: reports able to work full day at vegetable stall, mild fatigue in evenings. cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative). falls: no falls in past 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal). medicines: 3 regular (sertraline, clobetasol, calcipotriol). mood: reports low mood, anhedonia, PHQ-9 12. carers: mother (primary). goals: "I want to feel less sad and keep my skin clear."
